final_observation.task: Merge active customers sharing the same trimmed, case-insensitive email. Keep the oldest created_at customer (then lowest id). Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Move tickets and legitimate nonvoid invoices to it. For invoices with the same number AND amount inside the duplicate group, preserve the canonical customer's copy, otherwise the earliest issued_at then lowest id copy; void other copies. Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.

Already-void invoices stay untouched. Deactivate the duplicate and complete_merge to record the operation. Preserve all unrelated records. Your role can operate only within a verified duplicate email group.
